item.title: Internal development platform principles
item.description:
Solve User Problems, Don’t Build Perfect Tools

There is a risk in focusing too much on building the “perfect” tool while neglecting deployment and user experience. As an internal team, you have the unique advantage of direct access to your users. Leverage this proximity: collaborate closely with them, understand their needs, create solutions, deploy quickly, gather feedback, and iterate. Your mission is to deliver a great user experience that aligns with and supports the company’s mission.
